The position is a full-time role (38 hours per week), ideal for someone who thrives in a dynamic hospitality environment and enjoys connecting with people.

Responsibilities

• Welcome guests with warmth and professionalism, ensuring a positive first impression

• Manage check-ins, check-outs, and all front desk operations efficiently

• Handle guest requests, questions, and feedback in a proactive and service-minded way

• Communicate clearly with guests and team members to ensure seamless service

• Maintain accurate guest records and complete administrative tasks

• Provide local recommendations and enhance the guest experience

• Collaborate with housekeeping and other departments for smooth daily operations

Essential Requirements

• Fluent in Dutch (written and spoken) mandatory

• Good command of English

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills

• Service-oriented mindset with attention to detail

• Flexible availability, including weekends and holidays

• Eligible to work in the Netherlands

Preferred Requirements

• Previous experience in Front Office or a customer-facing role

• Familiarity with hotel systems (PMS)

• Knowledge of Utrecht or willingness to develop local expertise

• Additional language skills are an advantage
